text:
Raj Patel: Hey @Alicia  quick heads up, my lower back has been acting up the last week. Can we talk about moving me to a corner desk with an adjustable chair? Mornings are the worst. Also want to flag: Maya mentioned some performance concerns from the sprint  not trying to dodge that convo, just want an accommodation while we sort things out.

Maya Liu: Thanks for flagging, Raj. My note was around a couple missed deadlines and a few late PRs. Appreciate you raising the health side  we can absolutely adjust expectations. Lets sync and make a short plan.

Alicia (People Ops): Hi Raj  thanks for sharing. We can do an ER touchpoint. If you have a doctor's note that helps but not required to start a temporary accommodation. Would you prefer we handle a neutral sync with you and Maya, or do you want to manage the conversation yourself?

Raj Patel: I can get a doctor's note tomorrow. For immediacy I need a desk swap  desk 12 (corner, adjustable) would be ideal if available. If not, any adjustable chair + quieter corner works.

ErgoBot: Available desks with adjustable chairs in zone C: 12 (occupied), 14 (free), 18 (limited). Desk 12 currently assigned to @marta.

Maya Liu: I can approve a temporary swap to desk 14 for the next 2 weeks. Raj  Ill also pause two tasks and reassign one PR to keep deadlines realistic while you recover.

Raj Patel: Appreciate that. Also want to set expectations for code review turnaround  slower reviews ok for a couple weeks?

Jonah (People Ops): Ill draft a short accommodation memo for your file and for your manager. Raj  do you want the memo to read high-level ("temporary ergonomic accommodation") or include specifics (chair swap, reduced review burden, up to 3 remote days/week)? We only include details you consent to.

Raj Patel: High-level + the list is fine: "Temporary ergonomic accommodation  adjustable workstation; reduced on-call/review load; temporary remote flex for flare-ups (up to 3 days/week)."

Alicia (People Ops): Got it. Action items: facilities to arrange desk 14 + adjustable chair today, Jonah will create the accommodation note and mark check-in date in two weeks (March 30), Maya will pause/reassign the two sprint tickets. Confidential record will be logged.

Maya Liu: Ive reassigned PR reviews to Priya for the next 2 weeks and paused ticket RED-402 and RED-410.

Raj Patel: Thanks everyone. Quick Q  whats the policy if pain flares and I need to work remote for a few days?

Alicia (People Ops): You can use temporary remote up to 3 days/week for medical flare-ups with manager approval. Please submit a quick note via the accommodations form so we can track it: https://intranet.redwood/accom-form

Jonah (People Ops): Notifying facilities & labeling desk 14 as "Reserved (temp)  Raj Patel". Raj  once you have the doctor note, DM me or upload to the secure HR portal; wont be shared beyond People Ops + your manager unless you ask.

Raj Patel: Will do. Really appreciate the quick response and help coordinating.

Alicia (People Ops): No problem  reach out anytime. Well do a 10-min check-in next Friday to see how the setup is working. :thumbsup:
